veranderings.voor: dat die bronne verskil of laat die punt uit
veranderings.na: dat die bronne verskil, of laat die punt uit
veranderings.rede: Two separate instructions are joined by 'of' (as with the comma before 'maar' in 'Begin met vrae'); without the comma 'laat die punt uit' can be misread as part of what the learner writes.
Positive 'saak maak' echoes English 'matters'; 'belangrik is' is the more idiomatic Afrikaans with the same meaning.

vlae.teks: Die mens oor wie jy skryf, is 'n Suid-Afrikaner wat ons demokrasie help bou het. Skryf jou biografie in tydsorde van haar vroeë jare af. Leef sy nog, loop dit tot vandag toe.
vlae.rede: 'Die mens' is referred to as 'sy/haar' throughout the lesson (also in the list and 'onderhoud met haar'), which reads as if the learner's subject must be a woman; changing it would mean guessing the intent, so it is flagged, not changed.
